items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That night we play with them, but before that we got a jam session in the former Hilton, which is the Havana Libre hotel.

ctx.x: These musicians Dizzy Gillespie, Stan Getz, Earl “Fatha” Hines, and the other musicians who were on this cruise ship, how did you meet them?

That night we play with them, but before that we got a jam session in the former Hilton, which is the Havana Libre hotel. You’ll see at least a couple of pictures around there of Stan Getz in short pants and Fatha Hines was around there. We receive a call to meet these people there. They didn’t mention at all what was happening. “Present yourselves at Havana Libre hotel.”
